description.value: Liquor For Less – Ellwood is one of six Fraser Valley locations of a private liquor retailer that markets itself as consistently priced below government liquor stores with a large selection. Located in Ellwood Shopping Centre next to a Fruiticana grocery store, it offers beer, wine, and spirits and runs weekly flyer specials. Touring cyclists passing through Abbotsford could use it as a resupply stop for beverages.
